---
description: "Use when creating or editing Jupyter notebooks in this project. Restricts analysis libraries to pandas and matplotlib and requires Arabic code comments."
applyTo: "**/*.ipynb"
---

# Notebook Guidelines

- Use only `pandas` and `matplotlib` for data loading, analysis, and visualization. Do not introduce other third-party libraries such as NumPy or seaborn.
- Add concise Arabic comments in notebook code cells to explain the purpose of each analysis step. Keep comments accurate and relevant.
- Preserve the notebook's existing Arabic explanations and project conventions.
